content.short: Polkaswap is a non-custodial, cross-chain AMM DEX designed for Polkadot ecosystem and beyond.
content.description: Polkaswap is a next-generation decentralized exchange (DEX) that aims to redefine decentralized finance by employing a market-aggregation approach to trading. It helps lower transaction costs and speeds up trades by connecting liquidity providers directly with users and removing intermediaries. As a cross-chain exchange pioneer, it enables seamless transactions across multiple networks, supporting rapid swaps while maintaining security, transparency, and an open-source design that encourages broad collaboration among developers and traders alike.
